business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention sustaining business through past NWTF loans fund faster.
female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention using previous loans from NWTF to sustain their business activities accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

children-education-faster.title: Mentioning the education of children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-education-faster.body: Pitches that reference children's schooling or educational needs tend to accelerate funding for both male and female borrowers.

female-repayment-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention past loan repayment history may fund faster.

female-existing-demand-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention existing customer orders or demand may fund faster.

female-community-environment-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention environmental protection or their neighbors may fund faster.

female-family-future-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention securing their family's future may fund faster.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide personal demographics, such as age or marital status, may fund more slowly.

male-community-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention contributing to the well-being of the local community may fund more slowly.

female-children-count-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the specific number of children may fund more slowly.

female-expansion-dream-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention a dream to expand their business may fund faster.

female-descriptive-adjectives-slower.body: Female borrowers who use descriptive adjectives like 'hardworking' or 'dedicated' may fund more slowly.

female-character-traits-slower.title: Female borrowers using descriptive character traits like 'brave', 'inspiring', or 'hardworking' may fund more slowly.
female-character-traits-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that 'hardworking entrepreneur' predicted faster funding.

female-demographics-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific personal demographics, such as the number of children, fund faster.
female-demographics-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap of 8.

female-retail-inventory-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific retail inventory, such as canned goods and chips, may fund faster.

female-hardworking-slower.title: Female borrowers who use descriptors like 'hardworking' or 'works very hard' may fund more slowly.
female-hardworking-slower.retrospective: FIFO drop to maintain puzzle cap

female-land-prep-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention preparing land for farming may fund more slowly.

female-loan-amount-local-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.
